scopeNotes: This task adds test-only UAT binding verification; no production runtime route, contract, or data behavior changed.

The screen binding uses canonical 131-screen coverage, route resolution, source existence, owning completed-task evidence, and deterministic fixture checks rather than requiring screen-ID text in every implementation file.
Postman variable paths are normalized only for artifact parity comparison; the collection itself is unchanged.
ADM-54 remains covered by the owner-approved DESIGN-EXCEPTION-ADM-54 waiver and is not represented as a direct visual comparison.
Fixture catalog assertions reject credentials and other sensitive keys and do not represent Production data.
knownGaps: The repository does not define npm run security:check; the command was executed and recorded as unavailable rather than passed.
No live Production or external UAT credentials/data were used; verification is local and deterministic by design.
This task does not authorize a claim that every API has complete positive, negative, RBAC, ownership, state, upload, replay, concurrency, and journey coverage.
